ASSOCIATION OF ATTORNEYS, NOTICE & PROOF OF MAIL SERVICE: ROSSOFF, MICHAEL SHERWOOD ADDED AS ATTORNEY FOR CHOY, DONNA

THIS JUDGMENT WAS REACHED BY STIPULATION. PLAINTIFF, DONNA CHOY IS TO RECEIVE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF 3239 MISSION STREET, #5, SAN FRANCISCO. DEFENDANTS, MARTHA ESTRADA AND DANIEL ESTRADA ARE TO VACATE 3239 MISSION, #5 SAN FRANCISCO BY 1-31-95. THEY SHALL TURN THEIR KEYS OVER TO THE MANAGER IN APT. 7 AT 3239 MISSION STREET. THE SUM OF $895 WAS PAID TO DONNA CHOY BY DEFENDANTS, MARTHA ESTRADA AND DANIEL A. ESTRADA ON 1-4-95. ALL OTHER RENT IS WAIVED. IF DEFENDANTS MOVE OUT BY 1-31-95, THIS CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. ALL SECURITY DEPOSITES WILL BE RETAINED BY PLAINTIFF. THERE WILL BE A FULL RELEASE OF WAIVERS BY ALL SIDES. ANY PERSONAL PROPERTY LEFT BY DEFENDANTS SHALL BR DEEMED ABANDONED. THERE WILL BE A NEUTRAL REFERENCE BY THE LANDLORD. PLAINTIFF'S ATTORNEY SHALL ISSUE THE NECESSARY PAPER WORK. IF DEFENDANTS DANIEL ESTRADA AND MARTHA ESTRADA DO NOT SIGN THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT WITHIN 5 DAYS, THE AGREEMENT SHALL GO TO THE PRESIDING JUDGE FOR SIGNATURE.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ESTRADA, MARTHA L. ESTRADA, DANIEL A. THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 3239 MISSION STREET #5, SAN FRANCISCO, LEASE FORFEITED
